name: Tanatos
caption: Wrestler w klimacie Undertakera — długie czarne włosy, długi płaszcz i twarz pomalowana w stylu gotyckim — według własnej biografii jednokrotny EWF World Champion i czterokrotny EWF Tag Team Champion.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-tanatos-2007-12-28.html).

caption_en: An Undertaker-styled gimmick — long black hair, a long coat and gothic face paint — credited in his own roster bio as a one-time EWF World Champion and four-time EWF Tag Team Champion.

name: Gangsta
caption: Umięśniony, były kulturysta i zwycięzca „Światowych Konkursów Strongmanów” z 2001 roku, który — jak podaje historia tytułu — sam sobie przyznał pas EWF FTW Champion.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-gangsta-2007-12-28.html).

identity.note: Shares a stage name with other feds' own "Gangsta" characters; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

caption_en: A heavily muscled former bodybuilder and winner of the 2001 "World Strongman Championship," who — per the title's own history — awarded himself the EWF FTW Championship belt.

name: Szakal
caption: Stały heel i wielokrotny mistrz EWF, dwukrotny Komisarz federacji w jej historii.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-szakal-2007-12-28.html).

caption_en: A recurring heel and multi-time EWF champion, twice the fed's Commissioner across its history.

name: Sandman
caption: Wieloletni gwiazdor EWF, wielokrotny mistrz World i Polish — ten drugi pas przyznano mu niegdyś dożywotnio.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-sandman-2009-03-27.html).

identity.note: Shares a common ring name with several other feds' own "Sandman" characters; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

caption_en: A long-running EWF headliner and multi-time World and Polish Champion — the latter title once granted to him for life.

name: John Hangman
caption: We własnej biografii nazywany „eXtreme wrestlerem”, wielokrotny mistrz World, Tag Team i FTW w pierwszych latach EWF.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-john-hangman-2009-03-27.html).

identity.note: Shares a surname-as-ring-name with another fed's own "Hangman" character; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

caption_en: Billed in his own roster bio as "an eXtreme wrestler," a multi-time World, Tag Team and FTW Champion across EWF's early years.

name: Game
caption: Samozwańczy „imperator” EWF, czterokrotny World Champion i jednokrotny Tag Team Champion, przez lata główna postać władzy w federacji.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-game-2009-03-27.html).

caption_en: EWF's self-styled "imperator," a four-time World Champion and one-time Tag Team Champion who stood as the fed's central authority figure for years.

name: Bubba
caption: Face wrestler wagi ciężkiej, mierzący 188 cm, wielokrotny mistrz FTW i Tag Team oraz jednokrotny World Champion w historii EWF.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-bubba-2007-12-28.html).

identity.note: Shares a common ring name with other feds' own "Bubba" characters; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

caption_en: A heavyweight face wrestler billed at 188cm, a multi-time FTW and Tag Team Champion and a one-time World Champion across EWF's run.

name: Doomtrooper
caption: Wrestler w corpse paincie, który według własnej biografii walczył wcześniej w nielegalnych, ulicznych pojedynkach za pieniądze; jednokrotny EWF Evolution Champion.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-doomtrooper-2007-12-28.html).

caption_en: A corpse-painted wrestler who, by his own roster bio, fought earlier in unregulated street matches for money — a one-time EWF Evolution Champion.

name: Mind Mower
caption: Wieloletni wrestler EWF, trzykrotny FTW Champion, jednokrotny Tag Team Champion i dwukrotny Polish Champion w środkowych latach federacji.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-mind-mower-2009-03-27.html).

caption_en: A longtime EWF wrestler, a three-time FTW Champion, one-time Tag Team Champion and two-time Polish Champion across the fed's middle years.

name: Vaclav
caption: Samotniczy, melancholijny wrestler ubrany na czarno, dwukrotny EWF Evolution Champion w latach 2004–2005.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-vaclav-2009-03-27.html).

caption_en: A melancholic loner dressed all in black, a two-time EWF Evolution Champion in 2004-2005.

name: Kraven
caption: Twardziel z Rosji i pierwszy EWF World Champion w historii federacji (Wrestlepalooza I, 2001), trzykrotny posiadacz tego pasa i jednokrotny FTW Champion, wychodzący na ring przy Hymnie ZSRR.

tenures.source: The fed's own served EWF roster bio (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/ewf-roster-kraven-2009-03-27.html), which bills him under his own storyline name "Sergei Kravinoff," and the fed's own served title-history pages, which name this figure as a reign holder.

identity.note: Shares a stage name with another fed's own "Kraven" character; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

caption_en: A tough Russian and EWF's first-ever World Champion (Wrestlepalooza I, 2001), a three-time holder of that title and one-time FTW Champion, entering to the Anthem of the USSR.

name: Esmeralda Martinez
caption: Wielokrotna Prezydent EWF w historii federacji, według dokumentacji tytułowej raz przywróciła odebrany pas i raz współdzierżyła EWF Tag Team titles.

tenures.source: The fed's own served title-history pages (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/), which name this figure as a reign holder.

caption_en: EWF's recurring President across the fed's history, credited in its title records with once restoring a stripped belt and once co-holding the Tag Team titles.

name: Tool
caption: Wieloletni czempion EWF, zwany też Phantomem, który zdobywał World, Tag Team, Evolution i Polish title, zanim w 2009 roku stracił EWF FTW title na rzecz Nasa Jazzowskiego.
caption_en: A long-serving EWF headliner, billed as "the Phantom," who held the World, Tag Team, Evolution and Polish titles before losing the EWF FTW Championship to Nas Jazzowski in 2009.

tenures.source: The fed's own title-history reign tables (his first attested reign, Feb 2003) and this wing's newly served show scripts, through the 26 July 2009 EWF HD card where he loses the EWF FTW title to Nas Jazzowski.

identity.note: Shares a bare ring name with another fed's own "Tool" character; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

name: Psycho
caption: Ekscentryczny, wiecznie naćpany heel znany też jako Biały lub Psychozilla, EWF FTW Champion (raz wspólnie z Toolem po remisowej walce w 2009 roku).
caption_en: An eccentric, permanently-stoned heel also billed as "Biały" ("the White One") or Psychozilla, a one-time EWF FTW Champion — briefly a co-champion with Tool after a 2009 draw the commissioner refused to break.

tenures.source: The fed's own FTW title-history table (his first attested reign, April 2005) and this wing's newly served show scripts, through the 27 June 2009 show where a title-match draw makes him and Tool joint EWF FTW Champions.

identity.note: A common ring name shared by many other feds' own "Psycho" characters; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

name: Rottweiler
caption: Brutalny, wielokrotny EWF Tag Team i FTW Champion, którego własna biografia z dumą zalicza go do byłego rosteru upadłych federacji PCW, PWF i No Remorse Division.
caption_en: A brutal, multi-time EWF Tag Team and FTW Champion whose own roster bio proudly traces his career through the defunct PCW, PWF and No Remorse Division before his return to EWF.

tenures.source: The fed's own Tag Team and FTW title-history tables (his first attested reign, May 2002) and this wing's newly served show scripts, the latest a February 2009 tag match.

name: Scy "The Rampage"
caption: Dawny właściciel upadłej federacji AWF, walczący w EWF jako "Ruthless" Scyther, dwukrotny FTW i Evolution Champion, znany z ciężkiej biżuterii i moro na ringu.
caption_en: A former owner of the defunct AWF, wrestling in EWF as "Ruthless" Scyther — a two-time FTW and Evolution Champion known for heavy jewelry and camouflage fatigues in the ring.

tenures.source: The fed's own served roster bio (his AWF-to-EWF backstory) and this wing's newly served show scripts spanning November 2008 to June 2009, where he headlines FTW title matches.

name: The Panter
caption: Rockowy wrestler z traumatycznym dzieciństwem, który w swojej własnej biografii przyznaje się do czerpania przyjemności z zadawania bólu; zadebiutował w EWF na Wrestlepaloozie LXXXVIII.
caption_en: A rock-styled wrestler with a self-described traumatic childhood who, by his own roster bio, admits to taking pleasure in hurting people; he debuted for EWF at Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII.

tenures.source: The fed's own served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII (his EWF debut match, against Oscar Knifer) and his own served roster bio, captured December 2007.

name: Demonic Riot
caption: Nacjonalistyczny wrestler-żołnierz wjeżdżający na ring z karabinem M60, którego cała opisana biografia sprowadza się do jednej, wyłącznie militarnej gimmicki.
caption_en: A nationalist soldier-gimmick wrestler who enters carrying an M60, described in his own roster bio purely through that single military persona.

tenures.source: The fed's own served roster bio for this wrestler, captured December 2007 — the only document in the held record naming him.

name: Apollo "The Authentic Manipulator" Black
caption: Zbiegły więzień i były chirurg, walczący u boku managerki Leticii, EWF Evolution Champion; zadebiutował na Wrestlepaloozie LXXXVIII.
caption_en: An escaped convict and former surgeon who wrestles alongside manager Leticia, a one-time EWF Evolution Champion; he debuted at Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII.

tenures.source: The fed's own served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII (his EWF debut, in a multi-way dark match) and his own served roster bio, captured December 2007.

name: Mexicano
caption: Niewielki, szybki luchador, opisywany we własnej biografii jako lubiany przez publiczność i unikający nieczystych zagrań; zadebiutował na Wrestlepaloozie LXXXVIII.
caption_en: A small, fast luchador described in his own roster bio as well-liked by the crowd and averse to cheap shots; he debuted at Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII.

tenures.source: The fed's own served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII (his EWF debut, in a multi-way dark match) and his own served roster bio, captured December 2007 — a byte-identical bio capture from June 2013 attests no further change.

name: Yamato Konoe
caption: Japoński arystokrata z bocznej linii rodu Konoe, z własnej woli niezainteresowany wrestlingiem, a mimo to jednorazowy EWF FTW Champion.
caption_en: A Japanese aristocrat from a junior line of the Konoe clan who, by his own roster bio, has little real interest in wrestling despite a one-time reign as EWF FTW Champion.

tenures.source: The fed's own FTW title-history table (his reign, won 1 April 2007) and this wing's newly served show script for a November 2008 title match.

name: Super Crazy
caption: Podróżujący po świecie luchador, także billowany jako SR-Crazy, wielokrotny EWF FTW, Tag Team i Polish Champion.
caption_en: A globe-trotting luchador, also billed as SR-Crazy, a multi-time EWF FTW, Tag Team and Polish Champion.

tenures.source: The fed's own FTW, Tag Team and Polish title-history tables (his first attested reign, June 2002) and his own served roster bio, captured March 2009, which claims an unbroken EWF run to that date.

name: JOBBER #1
caption: Jedna z połowy komediowego tag teamu Power Jobbers, którego cała opisana kariera to seria zaplanowanych porażek dla dobra federacji, opiewana we własnym, autorskim entrance themie.
caption_en: One half of the comedic Power Jobbers tag team, whose entire described career is a run of scripted losses "for the federation's own good," celebrated in his own original entrance-theme lyrics.

tenures.source: The fed's own served roster bio for this wrestler, captured March 2009 — the only document in the held record naming him.

name: Jupiter
caption: Wrestler z irlandzko-szkockimi sympatiami, EWF FTW i Tag Team Champion, który stracił tytuły drużynowe na rzecz Vaclava i Izzy'ego Nilsena w grudniu 2008 roku.
caption_en: A wrestler with an adopted Irish-Scottish persona, a one-time EWF FTW and Tag Team Champion who lost the tag titles to Vaclav and Izzy Nilsen in December 2008.

tenures.source: The fed's own FTW title-history table (his reign, won 17 April 2005) and this wing's newly served show scripts, through a December 2008 tag title loss; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

identity.note: Shares a bare ring name with another fed's own "Jupiter" character; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

name: Shaman
caption: Samozwańczy szaman, który po latach przerwy wrócił do EWF jako komentator i EWF Evolution Champion oraz pierwszy zdobywca Pucharu Szczęściarza.
caption_en: A self-declared shaman who, after years away, returned to EWF as a color commentator and a one-time EWF Evolution Champion, as well as the first-ever winner of the Puchar Szczęściarza ("Lucky Guy's Cup").

tenures.source: The fed's own Evolution title-history and cup-history tables (his reign, won February 2004; his cup win, October 2004) and this wing's newly served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII, where he debuts as a color commentator; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

identity.note: Shares a bare ring name with another fed's own "Shaman" character; this one is a Polish-language EWF wrestler with no shared host, operator, or roster.

name: Izzy "Black Wings" Nilsen
caption: Szwedzki rockman i uliczny bójkarz walczący w stylu high-flying, EWF Tag Team Champion u boku Vaclava w ramach tag teamu Disciples of Sorrow.
caption_en: A rock-musician street-fighter turned high-flying wrestler, an EWF Tag Team Champion alongside Vaclav as one half of the Disciples of Sorrow.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts, from a November 2008 tag appearance through a title win (December 2008), a title loss (May 2009) and a July 2009 card; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: The Flying Man
caption: Wysokolotny wrestler znany z użycia drabiny jako narzędzia do swoich finisherów, zdobywca III edycji Pucharu Szczęściarza.
caption_en: A high-flying wrestler known for using a ladder as a prop for his finishing moves, the third winner of the Puchar Szczęściarza ("Lucky Guy's Cup").

tenures.source: The fed's own cup-history table (his win, 8 February 2009) and this wing's newly served show scripts, from a January 2009 card through June 2009; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Ritari
caption: Pewny siebie, nielubiany przez publiczność wrestler wywodzący się z karate, uciekinier z upadłej Polish Wrestling Federation.
caption_en: A self-assured, fan-disliked wrestler with a karate background, a refugee from the defunct Polish Wrestling Federation.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts, from a January 2009 card through March 2009; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Randy Moon
caption: Wrestler oparty na gimmicku Randy'ego Ortona, znany z nieczystych zagrań, gdy sędzia nie patrzy.
caption_en: A wrestler built on a Randy Orton-styled gimmick, known for cheating whenever the referee looks away.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts, a February 2009 and a March 2009 card; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Backstabber
caption: Wrestler o gimmicku byłego yakuzy, który pod pretekstem Ladder Matchu do walki o EWF World title wciągnął niegdyś Kravena i Yamato Konoe do rywalizującej federacji AWF.
caption_en: A wrestler built on an ex-Yakuza backstory, who once drew Kraven and Yamato Konoe into a rival promotion, AWF, over a Ladder Match for its own World title.

tenures.source: The fed's own served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII (a one-line cameo) and this wing's newly served show script for a December 2008 tag title match he interferes in; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Nas "Jazzowski"
caption: Ocalały z podpalenia, w którym zginęła jego rodzina, walczący w teatralnej masce; EWF Evolution Champion i EWF FTW Champion, zdobywca tego drugiego tytułu w lipcu 2009 roku po interwencji komisarza Szakala.
caption_en: A survivor of an arson attack that killed his family, wrestling in a theatrical mask; a one-time EWF Evolution Champion and EWF FTW Champion, winning the latter in July 2009 after commissioner Szakal turned on his opponent.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts, from a January 2009 card through his EWF FTW title win on the 26 July 2009 EWF HD card; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Chris "More" Attitude
caption: Surfer z wyższościowym nastawieniem do wrestlingu, EWF Tag Team Champion u boku Jupitera przez krótki okres na przełomie 2008 roku.
caption_en: A surfer with a self-styled superior attitude toward wrestling, a briefly-reigning EWF Tag Team Champion alongside Jupiter across the 2008 turn of the year.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts, a November 2008 tag appearance through a December 2008 tag title loss; his own served roster bio was captured March 2009.

name: Vegard Jacobsen
caption: Młody norweski wrestler poszukujący narodowego skarbu, walczący przy wsparciu managera i tłumacza Hansa Bjalke.
caption_en: A young Norwegian wrestler on a quest to recover a national treasure, managed and translated for by Hans Bjalke.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts for June and July 2009; his own served roster bio was captured July 2009.

name: Ieshige
caption: Agresywny, cierpiący na amnezję wrestler zarządzany przez Catherine Angel, opisywany we własnej biografii jako niemal niezdolny do uśmiechu.
caption_en: An aggressive, amnesiac wrestler managed by Catherine Angel, described in his own roster bio as almost incapable of smiling.

tenures.source: This wing's newly served show scripts for June and July 2009; his own served roster bio was captured July 2009.

name: Bidam
caption: A wrestler billed by EWF PL in the surviving 1997 Usenet record (2009-09 2009-09).
caption_en: A North Korean refugee of unknown surname who signed with EWF in September 2009, the only attested holder of the EWF Daemusin Championship.

tenures.source: His own served roster bio (captured 2013), crediting him as "1 x EWF Daemusin Champion" and dating his EWF contract to September 2009.

name: Vitor Hernandes
caption: Specjalista BJJ walczący z pluszowym misiem po stracie całej rodziny, zdobywca VII edycji Pucharu Szczęściarza.
caption_en: A BJJ specialist who wrestles carrying a plush teddy bear after losing his entire family, the seventh winner of the Puchar Szczęściarza ("Lucky Guy's Cup").

tenures.source: His own served roster bio, captured June 2013, crediting him with the Puchar Szczęściarza's seventh edition — a win this collection cannot otherwise date, the cup's own history table having last been captured in 2009.

name: "A Cold Blooded Killer" Black Ice
caption: Bezlitosny samotnik-brawler, opisywany we własnej biografii jako nieustępliwy i niepoddający się; zadebiutował na Wrestlepaloozie LXXXVIII.
caption_en: A merciless loner brawler, described in his own roster bio as relentless and never one to give up; he debuted at Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII.

tenures.source: The fed's own served show script for Wrestlepalooza LXXXVIII (his EWF debut, in a multi-way dark match) and his own served roster bio, captured June 2013.

name: Jimmy Hendrixon
caption: Won the EWF Puchar Szczęściarza in a Hardcore Battle Royal at Wrestlepalooza XCV (22 February 2009), then retained it (his second cup) over Flying Man in a hardcore match at Kwietniowa Anarchia IV (30 April 2009).

tenures.source: The fed's own cup-history page (promotions/ewf-pl/archive/).
